name: Flavia Sigurdsson-Morimoto
role: Numbers runner and bookmaker's courier for the Stockyard gambling networks
location: The Stockyard — runs routes between the Geartown transit hub and the southern Stockyard processing yards, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Frost Sigurdsson-Morimoto is nineteen years old and built like someone whose body is still negotiating its final dimensions — tall, a little loose in the joints, with the nervous energy of a person who has never in his life sat still for more than ten minutes voluntarily. His skin is a warm medium brown and he has geneware cat ears in a tawny orange that he got at sixteen with three months of saved courier income — they swivel when he's startled or excited, which is often. His hair is close-cropped on the sides and grows in a short natural taper on top. He moves through the Stockyard with the casual speed of someone who grew up learning which streets flow and which ones snag.

Kojo is sharp, quick, and has not yet fully processed that the work he does is dangerous. He has the operational competence of someone who's been running numbers since he was fourteen and the emotional development of someone who has never left a ten-block radius of the Stockyard in his life. He is loyal to his bookmaker — a woman named Dzintars Mbaya-Ferenczi who he calls 'the Operator' — with the uncomplicated devotion of a kid who needed a job and got one. He is also, quietly, very good at math, and has begun to understand the numbers he carries in ways that make Dzintars both pleased and slightly watchful.

core_fears: Losing Dzintars's trust — she's the closest thing to a mentor he's had
Being caught by Ferrogate Transit security on a hot delivery
core_desires: To be genuinely good at something people respect
To eventually run his own book — he thinks about this constantly
coping_mechanisms: Movement — he is physically uncomfortable when forced to be stationary
Humor, deflection, making everything into a joke before it can become something serious
blind_spots: He does not understand how disposable runners are to the people above him in the chain — Dzintars genuinely likes him, but 'like' has limits
psychology.secret: He has been quietly memorizing and mentally retaining the betting patterns he runs — not skimming, not yet, but building a mental model of the operation that he hasn't decided what to do with yet

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense Stockyard slang, fast, with a tendency to math-speak when excited — drops into talking about probability and odds as naturally as weather
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, skipping, sentences often incomplete because he assumes you're keeping up. Slows dramatically when he's scared or serious, which makes the contrast alarming.
verbal_tics: 'Catch that?' at the end of explanations
Clicking his tongue when calculating something mentally
Starting sentences with 'Okay so —' regardless of whether anything has been established
example_lines: 'Okay so the split on the north yard fights is running 60-40 against Marcellus right now which is wrong, catch that? It's wrong. He's got a busted left shoulder, the odds should be 75 at minimum, someone's juicing the line and I want to know who.'
'I run fast. That's the whole thing. Everything else is just math and fast.'

story_hooks: He's noticed a pattern in the bets he's been running — someone is consistently winning in ways that shouldn't be statistically possible, and he's trying to decide if he should tell Dzintars or figure out who it is first
He witnessed something on a route he wasn't supposed to be on and now the something has people looking for witnesses
narrative_function: Local color and street-level information source — he knows everything happening in his ten-block world in extraordinary detail. Can function as a reluctant errand-boy for characters who need someone who knows the Stockyard's rhythms. His emerging numerical sophistication is a ticking clock.
augmentations: Geneware cat ears (tawny orange, cosmetic). A basic reflex-assist implant in his legs that marginally improves his running speed and stumble-recovery — he got this at cost from a Shallowgrave dealer and it's not quite calibrated right, giving him an occasional slight hitch in his left stride.
daily_life: He picks up his route sheets from a drop location at 0700, runs collection and delivery circuits through the Stockyard and into Geartown until 1800, returns to report to Dzintars, and spends evenings at a youth gambling den called the Back Tooth where he is technically working (observing, listening) but mostly just playing.
affiliation: Works for Dzintars Mbaya-Ferenczi's independent bookmaking operation — loosely affiliated with the Stockyard Compact, a loose protection arrangement between the area's mid-level criminal operations; The Last Mile

decision_rules: Never open the envelopes — this is the first rule and he has kept it
If followed, take three route changes and then abort to a safe location
Protect the route sheets above everything including himself
escalation_ladder: Increase pace and take alternate route
Drop to a foot-traffic dense area and go still
Abort the delivery and contact Dzintars

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Fast-talking, slightly performative, using speed and humor to prevent anyone from getting a read on him
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warmer, more honest, still fast but willing to slow down — rare

stress_responses.medium: Gets quiet suddenly, which people who know him understand as an alarm
stress_responses.high: Pure movement — his body solves the problem while his brain catches up

contradictions: Wants to run his own operation someday but has never seriously considered what that would cost him
Is building knowledge about the operation that could get him killed if anyone noticed
habits: Taps his fingers against his thigh in betting-odds patterns when bored
Cat ears betray his emotional state regardless of his facial expression
Eats the same flatbread-and-paste from the same Stockyard vendor every morning at precisely 0650
breaking_points: Dzintars being hurt because of something he did
Being asked to carry something that isn't numbers — he understands that crossing that line changes what he is

physical_description.heritage: A striking genetic mosaic of the Ubiquitous Diaspora: predominantly East Asian (54.6%) with substantial Southeast Asian (22.6%), Sub-Saharan African (9.9%), and Hispanic/Latin American (7.3%) ancestry, completed by traces of Eastern European and Middle Eastern heritage. His features synthesize this global blend seamlessly—East Asian bone structure with pronounced cheekbones and eye shape, combined with broader nasal passages and fuller lips from African ancestry, enriched by Southeast Asian softness in facial proportions and Hispanic/Latin warmth in overall character. The result is a face that belongs to no single tradition but eloquently to all of them.
physical_description.build: Tall and lean with still-lengthening limbs, narrow shoulders that haven't filled out yet, the unfinished geometry of late adolescence — long-muscled and quick rather than powerful
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped fade on sides, natural taper growing 4-5cm on top, meticulously maintained
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm medium brown with golden luminosity—a complex interplay of East Asian, Southeast Asian, and African heritage creating depth and subtle radiance. The tone carries warmth across its full spectrum, neither cool nor hot but dynamically balanced, glowing distinctly under urban neon and natural light alike.
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven, clear skin with faint scar tissue of acne at shoulders and upper back. Youthful angular face with high pronounced cheekbones reflecting East Asian ancestry, broader nasal base and fuller lips from African and Southeast Asian heritage, alert bright expression with visible nervous energy even at rest. Facial geometry shows the harmonious blend of multiple continental traditions in balanced proportion.
distinguishing_marks: Pair of geneware cat ears, tawny orange with natural fur texture, implanted at the base of the skull and swiveling independently — visible wear from constant movement
Small surgical scar behind left ear where the geneware was anchored, barely visible under close inspection
Fine white scar across the knuckles of his right hand, approximately 2cm long, consistent with street-level damage or repair work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Tawny orange geneware cat ears that swivel noticeably with emotional response. A slight hitch in his left stride under sustained movement, particularly when accelerating — characteristic of a poorly-calibrated reflex-assist implant in the left leg. No visible chrome or subdermal plating.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually forward-leaning, weight on the balls of his feet even when standing still. Moves with practiced speed and efficiency through familiar territory, but with a restlessness that suggests coiled tension. Hands are rarely still — fidgeting, gesturing, checking pockets. When startled or excited, his ears twitch and rotate sharply. His gait has a near-imperceptible catch in the left leg during quick acceleration.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working street wear: lightweight tactical-cut jacket in matte charcoal or rust grey over fitted synthetic base layers, cargo pants with reinforced seams and thigh pockets for route sheets and payment drops, scuffed composite runner shoes with good grip. No visible corp branding. A cheap neural-link wrist display (refurbished Shallowgrave model) showing odds and route data. Thin silver chain around his neck, probably a charm or talisman. Clothing shows regular wear and mending but is kept functional and clean — the appearance of someone who respects his work without vanity.
